title: Emotion Tracker: Daily Mood
description: Simple Daily Emotion Tracker is the easy way to understand your emotions, spot patterns, and build emotional strength over time.
longDescription:
Simple Daily Emotion Tracker is the easy way to understand your emotions, spot patterns, and build emotional strength over time.

Log your feelings in seconds with an intuitive emotion wheel, add quick notes or tags, and watch your streaks grow as you check in daily. Our AI-powered insights help you uncover trends, like how sleep or daily habits affect your mood, while integrating with HealthKit for even deeper patterns.

Whether you're looking to manage stress and anxiety, boost self-awareness, improve relationships, or simply feel more in control, Simple Daily Emotion Tracker turns everyday check-ins into powerful habits for emotional fitness.

**Key Features:**

- Quick daily logging with a beautiful emotion wheel and intensity sliders
- Gamified streaks and badges to keep you motivated
- AI insights and predictions based on your personal patterns
- Stunning charts and calendar views for progress tracking
- Custom tags and reminders for personalized reflection
- Seamless HealthKit integration to connect moods with sleep, energy, and activity
- Secure cloud sync, your data is private and always backed up

**Unlock Pro for Even More:**

- Unlimited entries and advanced AI forecasts
- Detailed trend analysis and exports
- Custom themes and deeper customizations

Start tracking today and discover what makes you thrive.

legal.privacyPolicy:
**1. Introduction**

Welcome to Emotion Tracker: Daily Mood ("the App"). We respect your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal data. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and safeguard your information when you use our App.

**2. Information We Collect**

*Data You Provide:*
- Mood and emotion entries (feelings, intensity levels, notes)
- Custom tags and labels you create
- Account information (email address if you create an account)
- Feedback and support communications

*Automatically Collected Data:*
- Device information (device type, operating system version)
- App usage analytics (features used, session duration)
- Crash reports and performance data

*HealthKit Data (Optional):*
- With your explicit permission, we may access sleep, activity, and other health metrics from Apple HealthKit to provide mood correlation insights. This data is processed locally on your device and is never sold or shared with third parties.

**3. How We Use Your Information**

We use your data to:
- Provide and improve the App's core functionality
- Generate personalized insights and mood pattern analysis
- Power AI-driven features (mood predictions, trend analysis)
- Sync your data securely across your devices
- Send optional reminders and notifications
- Respond to support requests
- Improve app performance and fix bugs

**4. AI-Powered Features**

Our App uses AI technology to analyze your mood patterns and provide insights. When you use AI features:
- Your mood data may be processed by our AI service providers
- Data is anonymized and aggregated where possible
- We do not use your personal mood entries to train AI models
- You can opt out of AI features in Settings

**5. Data Storage and Security**

- Your data is encrypted both in transit and at rest
- We use industry-standard security measures to protect your information
- Cloud-synced data is stored on secure servers
- You can export or delete your data at any time from within the App

**6. Data Sharing**

We do NOT sell your personal data. We may share data only:
- With service providers who help us operate the App (cloud hosting, analytics)
- If required by law or to protect our legal rights
- With your explicit consent

**7. Third-Party Services**

The App may use:
- RevenueCat for subscription management
- Analytics services for app improvement
- Cloud services for data backup

These services have their own privacy policies governing their use of data.

**8. Your Rights**

You have the right to:
- Access your personal data
- Correct inaccurate data
- Delete your data
- Export your data
- Opt out of analytics
- Withdraw consent for optional features

**9. Children's Privacy**

The App is not intended for children under 13. We do not knowingly collect data from children under 13. If you believe a child has provided us with personal data, please contact us.

**10. Changes to This Policy**

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of significant changes through the App or via email.

**11. Contact Us**

If you have questions about this Privacy Policy or your data, please contact us at the email address provided below.
